comparison.objective: Replace two shelf-edge price tickets while preserving the third ticket and cans.
comparison.physical_skill: Open a strip, extract thin cards, insert replacements into a narrow channel, and close it.
comparison.success_condition: Correct new tickets must be seated under their cans, old tickets discarded, strip closed, and cans undisturbed.
comparison.reason: It tests thin-object extraction and channel insertion with identity matching. It lacks continuous support transfer and rolling-element loss prevention.
